title: Aran & Shade Growth Support Event
author: MapleStory M
summary: New Aran and Shade characters could register for the May 21-July 8 growth-support event, complete progression goals, and earn class growth rewards.

sections.title: Event scope
items: The event supported newly created Aran and Shade characters.
Registration and progression rewards were available during the announced event window.

notes: Structured summary verified against the official Nexon Forum event notice on 2026-07-27.
eligibility: Newly created Aran and Shade characters
requirements: Register an eligible character and complete the growth goals.
participation_steps: Create an eligible Aran or Shade.
Register the character for the event.
Complete growth milestones and claim rewards.
